newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Electricidad Q1 seen profitable.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Electricidad Q1 seen profitable.

text.p: Leading Venezuelan utility Electricidad de Caracas expects a first quarter profit due to rate rises awarded in 1996, a high placed source said.
"This time last year we were suffering from a prolonged delay of rate rises," said the source, who asked not to be identified.
Rate rises granted through the course of last year "will see us reap some profits this quarter."
In last year's first quarter, ended in May, the company reported a 3.5 billion bolivar net loss for the first quarter.
The source added that electricity consumption in Caracas, which the company serves, "is beginning to rise this year after falling last."
